payload.claim: SoundGuys picks Sony ULT WEAR as best overall headphones under 200 dollars, combining effective ANC, long battery and a compact foldable over-ear design.
payload.quote: Sony ULT WEAR are our best overall pick because they combine effective ANC, long battery life, and broad connectivity in a compact, foldable over-ear package.

payload.claim: In lab tests ULT WEAR give more than 25dB attenuation above 80Hz, well suited to commutes.
payload.quote: In lab testing they lasted 32 hours and 35 minutes and deliver more than 25dB of attenuation above 80Hz, making them well suited for commutes and travel.

payload.claim: ULT WEAR earned SoundGuys Best ANC and Best for Comfort recognition.
payload.quote: The ULT WEAR also earned Best ANC, Best Battery Life, Best Call Quality, Best Over-Ear Headphones, Best for iPhone users and Best for Comfort recognition.

payload.claim: ULT WEAR are bass-forward and SoundGuys recommends using app EQ to tame the bass boost.
payload.quote: Our MDAQS assessment shows the ULT WEAR are bass-forward, so we recommend using the app EQ to tame the ULT button

payload.claim: Anker describes the soundcore Space 2 as the best choice if comfort and battery life are the top priorities.
payload.quote: The soundcore Space 2 is the best choice if comfort and battery life are your top priorities.

payload.claim: SoundGuys says Soundcore Space One folds and feels lightweight.
payload.quote: The headphones fold, feel lightweight, and include USB-C charging plus an auxiliary cable for wired listening when needed.

payload.claim: JBL Live 670NC is on-ear, not over-ear.
payload.quote: The on-ear form factor makes them highly portable

payload.claim: What Hi-Fi? says XM5 are among the class leaders at isolating train and underground drone.
payload.quote: among the class leaders when it comes to isolating us from constant drones and noises within train and underground carriages.

payload.claim: XM5 comfort is up there with the best with just the right clamping force.
payload.quote: Comfort levels are up there with the best and the Sonys deliver just the right amount of clamping force, so they feel secure without threatening to crush our ears.

payload.claim: XM5 have been superseded by XM6 and remain recommendable.
payload.quote: although they have now been superseded by the Sony WH-1000XM6, the XM5 remain a highly recommendable pair of wireless headphones.

payload.claim: Ideal Home says JBL Live 650BTNC ANC is good but not a patch on Bose or Sony.
payload.quote: When it comes to giving you some peace, the noise-cancelling is good but not a patch on the Bose or Sony.

payload.claim: Major HiFi says Sennheiser Accentum has effective ANC and long battery.
payload.quote: Beyond sound, it brings a well-rounded feature set that includes effective active noise cancellation for everyday environments and an impressively long battery life that easily supports extended listening sessions.

payload.claim: ANC works best on steady low-frequency noise such as train rumble.
payload.quote: It works best on steady, low-frequency noise, such as train rumble, aircraft engines, traffic and air conditioning.

payload.claim: For long train journeys lightweight design and soft cushions can matter as much as ANC strength.
payload.quote: For office work, long train journeys and flights, lightweight design and soft cushions can be just as important as ANC strength.

payload.claim: JLab JBuds Lux ANC has respectable ANC for the price.
payload.quote: The headphones deliver respectable ANC for the price
